items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: I see Batman, Buddy Williams played drums.

ctx.x: Ranking. D-Roy Ranking. I see Batman, Buddy Williams played drums. Frank Field was playing bass. Smiley Lewis was playing guitar.
And he played with your band. When you would go on stage he would accompany you and play guitar.
